messages.content: Is anything wrong in this? The soup is very hot, I can't drink it now.

The soup is very hot, so I can't drink it now.
Why: conjunction (comma splice -> ", so").
I felt very embarrassing when everyone laughed at my answer. Is this right?

I felt very embarrassed when everyone laughed at my answer.
Why: verb form ("embarrassing" -> "embarrassed").
He did a bad decision when he left the project. Please fix the verb.

He made a bad decision when he left the project.
Why: word choice ("did a bad decision" -> "made a bad decision").
Every one of the trees in our street have been painted white. Spot the mistake.

Every one of the trees in our street has been painted white.
Why: subject-verb agreement ("Every one ... have" -> "has").
This is the most good game I have ever watched. Please correct it.

This is the best game I have ever watched.
Why: superlative ("most good" -> "best").
This lake is deeper than any other lakes in the state. What is wrong?

This lake is deeper than any other lake in the state.
Why: plural ("other lakes" -> "other lake").
Their are two fans in my bedroom, but one doesn't works. Help me with this.

There are two fans in my bedroom, but one doesn't work.
Why: spelling ("Their" -> "There"); verb form ("doesn't works" -> "doesn't work").
We got down from the bus at the wrong stop. Is "got down" okay?

We got off the bus at the wrong stop.
Why: preposition ("got down from" -> "got off").
Nobody have called me since morning. What should the verb be?

Nobody has called me since morning.
Why: subject-verb agreement ("have" -> "has" for "nobody").
Add little salt and stir till the sugar dissolve. Is there anything to fix?

Add a little salt and stir till the sugar dissolves.
Why: article ("Add little" -> "Add a little"); subject-verb agreement ("sugar dissolve" -> "sugar dissolves").
The exam results will be announced next week. Is "will be announced" right?

That is fine.
Why: no error (future tense: "will be announced" is correct).
What is the reason of the delay in the courier? Please correct it.

What is the reason for the delay in the courier?
Why: preposition ("reason of" -> "reason for").
I will can join you after the meeting next week. Is "will can" allowed?

I will be able to join you after the meeting next week.
Why: verb form ("will can" -> "will be able to").
You needn't to bring anything; we have everything. What is wrong?

You needn't bring anything; we have everything.
Why: extra word ("needn't to bring" -> "needn't bring").
Her buisness sells handmade soaps and candles. Fix the spelling, please.

Her business sells handmade soaps and candles.
Why: spelling ("buisness" -> "business").
I couldn't find my ticket nowhere in the bag. What is wrong?

I couldn't find my ticket anywhere in the bag.
Why: negative ("couldn't ... nowhere" -> "anywhere").
Thank you for your helping me with the project. Is "your helping" right?

Thank you for helping me with the project.
Why: extra word ("your helping" -> "helping").
Can I play too? Said the little boy. Please fix the punctuation.

"Can I play too?" said the little boy.
Why: punctuation ("Can I play too? Said" -> "\"Can I play too?\" said").
Can I have another two biscuits, please? Is "another two" okay, or should it be "two more"?

Both are correct, so your sentence needs no change.
Why: no error (word choice: "another two" is correct).
Can you recomend a good mystery for the holidays? Spelling, please.

Can you recommend a good mystery for the holidays?
Why: spelling ("recomend" -> "recommend").
